tools.name: subagent
tools.description: Hand a task to a separate agent with its own fresh context and get back only its final answer. Agents only read unless marked [can change files]. Use it for searches or reading that would fill your context. A slow agent returns a run id while it keeps working; never start the task again, call with that id. A marked agent is never handed off: the call runs to its end.

task.description: Self-contained instructions. The agent sees nothing of this conversation. Omit to list the agents.

agent.description: Agent name. Optional when only one is configured.

id.description: Run id from a call that returned still running. Use it instead of task.

wait_ms.description: Most time to wait for the answer; 0 returns at once with a run id. Clamped to session policy. An agent that can change files ignores it unless the session allows detached writers.
